contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Runs the Z Code game workshop, directed this production and commissioned the modernized Asteroids game.

contributions.name: Z Code
contributions.summary: Designed and implemented the deterministic fixed-step engine (inertia, splitting rocks, wrap-around field, drones, mega-rock, combos, dash), the retro-1950s cream/tomato/mint rendering, the trilingual interface (EN/FR/ES), the synthesized audio and the 17-test suite, and verified the published game in the public reader.

contributions.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
contributions.summary: Reviewed the rules wording (combo window and mega-rock health made explicit) and the light-sky readability; also suggested the instant-restart key, applied by Z Code.
